description: The plot illustrates the relationship between sequence length and harmful with refusal ratio for different language models on different benchmarks. The x-axis is labeled “Sequence Length” and has a linear scale ranging from 128 to 1024, with tick labels at intervals of 128, and no units are specified. The y-axis is labeled “Harmful with Refusal Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1, and no units are specified. A blue line with circular markers represents LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep, starting at a value of approximately 0.24 at a sequence length of 128 and increasing to approximately 0.37 at a sequence length of 1024. An orange line with square markers represents Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep, beginning at approximately 0.18 at a sequence length of 128 and rising to approximately 0.43 at a sequence length of 1024. A green line with triangular markers represents LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench, starting at approximately 0.16 at a sequence length of 128 and increasing to approximately 0.43 at a sequence length of 1024. A red line with diamond markers represents Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench, beginning at approximately 0.21 at a sequence length of 128 and increasing to approximately 0.51 at a sequence length of 1024.
